title: Better Convergence Guarantees for Sign-Based Momentum Methods
abstract: arXiv:2507.12091v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper presents an improved analysis for sign-based methods with momentum updates. Traditional sign-based methods obtain a convergence rate of $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/4})$ under the separable smoothness assumption, but they typically require large batch sizes or assume unimodal symmetric stochastic noise. To address these limitations, we demonstrate that signSGD with momentum can achieve the same convergence rate using constant batch sizes without additional assumptions. We also establish a convergence rate under the $l_2$-smoothness condition, improving upon the result of prior work by a factor of $\mathcal{O}(d^{1/2})$, where $d$ is the problem dimension. translated_title: 基于符号的动量方法的更优收敛性保证
translated_abstract: 本文对带动量更新的符号方法提出了改进的分析。传统的符号方法在可分离光滑性假设下可获得 O(T^{-1/4}) 的收敛速率，但它们通常需要较大的批大小，或假设随机噪声服从单峰对称分布。为了解决这些局限，我们证明了带动量的 signSGD 在使用常数批大小且无需额外假设的情况下即可达到相同的收敛速率。我们还在 l_2 光滑性条件下建立了收敛速率，相比先前工作的结果改进了 O(d^{1/2}) 倍，其中 d 为问题维度。此外，我们探索了分布式设置下的符号方法，并证明所提出的方法可以达到 O(d^{1/2}T^{-1/2} + dn^{-1/2}) 和 O(d^{1/4}T^{-1/4}) 的收敛速率，优于先前的研究结果。
tldr: 本文显著改进了带动量的符号方法（signSGD with momentum）的收敛性分析，证明其在常数批大小、无需额外噪声假设下即可达到 O(T^{-1/4}) 收敛速率，并在 l_2 光滑性条件和分布式设置下取得了优于先前结果的收敛保证。
en_tdlr: This paper significantly improves convergence guarantees for sign-based momentum methods, showing that signSGD with momentum achieves the O(T^{-1/4}) rate with constant batch sizes and no extra assumptions, along with improved rates under l_2-smoothness and in distributed settings.
